title: Rigidity of Completely Close $C^*$-Algebras
exact_target: For $C^*$-algebras $A,B\subseteq B(H)$, what structural properties and invariants are forced by small completely bounded Kadison–Kastler distance $d_{\mathrm{cb}}(A,B)$, and must sufficiently close algebras be isomorphic?
